content: TCC attributes a CLI's mic request to the responsible process (the terminal app, or nearest signed ancestor with a bundle identity); bare CLI can embed Info.plist via linker -sectcreate __TEXT __info_plist with NSMicrophoneUsageDescription. tccutil reset Microphone resets. Homebrew 5.0 audits casks for codesigning+notarization, unsigned casks scheduled for disable by 2026-09-01; formulas built from source in a tap are not quarantined. Swift formulas use swift build -c release --disable-sandbox.
